title: Елена заступает на смену  (Elena Starts Her Shift)

segments.t: Seconds after Chef Barinov dives into hiding, Nagiyev leads Elena Pavlovna into the kitchen and introduces her as the acting head chef during Barinov's medical leave. Meanwhile in the corridor, Ilya needles Max by asking if Sasha has dumped him yet.
Сейчас сюда придет Елена Павловна.
Что ж у нас?
Внимание все сюда, пока наш шеф-повар.
Вот. Внимание все сюда.
Да, пока наш шеф-повар отдыхает, так сказать.
Лечится. Да.
Значит, с вами сегодня будет вот Елена Павловна.
Волноваться нечего.
Все, ни пуха ни пера.
Что еще?
Мы что, нормально общаться не можем?
Нет, у нас все хорошо.
Тебя Саша бросил?
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
Сейчас сюда придет Елена Павловна.
'Elena Pavlovna is coming in here right now.' Pointing out that Elena Pavlovna is coming in here right now gives Elena a sobering reality check.
Что ж у нас?

'What are we going to do?' Here wondering what they going to do are shows Sasha looking for the real truth. In Russian you say "by me" or "with us" rather than "I have", so the situation sits right with the person.
Внимание все сюда, пока наш шеф-повар.
'Everyone pay attention, while our head chef...' Around the conversation and situation, Elena sets a calm, everyday tone with Barinov.
Вот. Внимание все сюда.
'Here we are. Everyone pay attention.' Noting that here they are keeps Barinov's side of the story simple and clear.
Да, пока наш шеф-повар отдыхает, так сказать.
'Yes, while our head chef is resting, so to speak.' Even though while their head is resting so to speak, Sasha keeps a steady face in front of Barinov.
Лечится. Да.
'Getting medical treatment. Yes.' Between the conversation and the situation, Elena gives Barinov a quick, grounded response.
Значит, с вами сегодня будет вот Елена Павловна.

'Elena Pavlovna right here will be working with you today.' Saying that Elena Pavlovna right here will be working with Elena today is how Barinov sets the tone with Elena. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
Волноваться нечего.
'There is nothing to worry about.' Once there is nothing to worry, Sasha can finally tell Barinov what she means.
Все, ни пуха ни пера.
'Alright, best of luck to you all.' Between the work and the truth, Elena gives Barinov a quick, grounded response.
Что еще?
'What now?' Around the room and kitchen, Barinov wants to know where Elena really stands. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
Мы что, нормально общаться не можем?

'Can we not just talk to each other normally?' Asking whether they not just talk to each other normally cuts straight through the tension between Sasha and Barinov. In Russian, she does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
Нет, у нас все хорошо.
'No, everything is fine between us.' Mentioning that everything is fine between them moves the talk in a new direction.
Тебя Саша бросил?

'Did Sasha dump you?' Here checking whether Sasha dump Elena shows Barinov looking for the real truth. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Сейчас сюда придет Елена Павловна.
Что ж у нас?
Внимание все сюда, пока наш шеф-повар.
Вот. Внимание все сюда.
Да, пока наш шеф-повар отдыхает, так сказать.
Лечится. Да.
Значит, с вами сегодня будет вот Елена Павловна.
Волноваться нечего.
Все, ни пуха ни пера.
Что еще?
Мы что, нормально общаться не можем?
Нет, у нас все хорошо.
Тебя Саша бросил?
That wraps up this scene as nagiyev introduces Elena Pavlovna to the stunned kitchen crew as their temporary chef while Barinov hides, and Ilya taunts Max about Sasha in the hallway. Until next time!
До встречи!
